item.title: How to Verify a True Factory on 1688 vs Trading Middlemen (4 Chinese Characters Checklist)
item.description: Learn the exact 4 Chinese business license characters (生产/制造/加工 vs 批发/贸易) to filter out 65% of 1688 middlemen and save 25%-45% on EXW factory pricing.
item.content:encoded:
Roughly 65% to 70% of suppliers on 1688.com and Alibaba are trading companies or domestic resellers marking up factory EXW prices by 25% to 45%. Before ordering a single sample, run this 4-step verification checklist:

1. Inspect the Business License Scope (经营范围)

Click the supplier registration badge (企业档案) on 1688 and inspect the 经营范围 (Business Scope) line:

  • True Manufacturer: Must explicitly include 生产 (Production), 制造 (Manufacturing), or 加工 (Processing).
  • Trading Middleman: Lists only 批发 (Wholesale), 零售 (Retail), 贸易 (Trading), or 电子商务 (E-commerce).

2. Match the City to China Primary Industrial Belts (源头产业带)

Injection-molded acrylic and plastic organizers belong in Ningbo/Taizhou (Zhejiang); small pet appliances belong in Suzhou/Ningbo; LED signs belong in Shenzhen/Zhongshan.

3. Check for Bull Head (牛头实力商家) or Super Factory (超级工厂) + 25%+ Repurchase Rate (回头率)

Basic Chengxintong membership only costs 6,688 RMB/year. Look for TUV/SGS onsite audited Super Factories and a 30-day buyer repurchase rate above 25%.

Run the interactive 6-factor 1688 True Factory Scorer and copy our native Chinese AliWangWang/WeChat negotiation script free at SinoScout (https://sinoscout.vercel.app/).

item.title: 1688 to Amazon FBA & TikTok Shop US Landed Cost Calculator (RMB to USD + DDP Freight)
item.description: Compare 1688 direct factory EXW pricing against AliExpress middlemen with real-time RMB-to-USD conversion, Air/Sea DDP freight per kg, and USITC HTS duties.
item.content:encoded:
When scaling a product on Amazon FBA or TikTok Shop US, switching from AliExpress ($11.50/unit) to a verified 1688 Ningbo factory (24 RMB / $3.59 EXW) can increase your net margin from 38.2% to 60.1%—adding over $1,350 in extra net profit on a 200-unit batch.

Complete Landed Cost Formula (Per Unit)

  • 1. Factory EXW + CN Domestic Freight: (RMB Price + 2.5 RMB domestic shipping to Shenzhen/Yiwu 3PL) / USD-CNH FX Rate.
  • 2. Cross-Border DDP Freight + 3PL Prep: (Unit Weight kg * $2.20 Sea DDP or $5.80 Air DDP) + $0.20 FNSKU/QC fee.
  • 3. US Customs HTS Duty + Section 301 Tariff: Declared EXW USD * Combined HTS Duty Rate (e.g., 11.4% for HTS 3926.10).

Test your exact SKU margins free with the interactive SinoScout 1688-to-US Landed Cost Calculator.

item.title: US China Section 301 Tariff & HTS Duty Cheat Sheet for E-Commerce Importers
item.description: Quick reference guide to combined MFN base duties and Section 301 China tariffs across top e-commerce HTS categories.
item.content:encoded:
Importing from 1688 or Alibaba into the United States requires accounting for both the Most Favored Nation (MFN) base duty and Section 301 China tariffs:

  • HTS 3926.10.00 (Plastic & Acrylic Organizers): 3.9% Base + 7.5% Sec. 301 = 11.4% Total Duty
  • HTS 8509.80.50 (Small Home & Pet Appliances): 3.9% Base + 25.0% Sec. 301 = 28.9% Total Duty
  • HTS 9405.42.80 (LED Signs & Decorative Lamps): 2.7% Base + 7.5% Sec. 301 = 10.2% Total Duty
  • HTS 4202.92.31 (Travel Bags & Cases): 12.0% Base + 7.5% Sec. 301 = 19.5% Total Duty
